steps.tx: Cancer cells exploit co-inhibitory receptor signalling pathways to evade physiological immune-mediated destruction. **PD-1 inhibitors** nivolumab and pembrolizumab block PD-1 interactions with PD-L1 and PD-L2, reversing T-cell exhaustion and restoring **cytotoxic T-lymphocyte** antitumor immunity. Disruption of PD-1 signalling disinhibits effector T cells within the tumour microenvironment, promoting cytolytic granule release, interferon-gamma production, and durable objective tumour regression.

steps.tx: Targeting the ligand rather than the receptor preserves alternative physiological regulatory interactions. **PD-L1 inhibitors** atezolizumab, durvalumab, and avelumab prevent PD-L1 from engaging PD-1 and B7.1, leaving the PD-L2/PD-1 **regulatory axis** intact. Spared PD-L2 signalling helps prevent excessive immune-mediated pulmonary toxicity, distinguishing PD-L1 antibodies biologically from monoclonal antibodies targeting the PD-1 receptor directly.

left.title: PD-1 Inhibitors (Nivolumab, Pembrolizumab)
items: Directly bind PD-1 receptor on activated T lymphocytes
Block both PD-L1 and PD-L2 binding to PD-1
Higher rate of immune-mediated pneumonitis observed clinically
Effective across broad solid and haematological malignancies

right.title: PD-L1 Inhibitors (Atezolizumab, Durvalumab)
items: Bind PD-L1 on tumour cells and antigen-presenting cells
Block PD-L1 binding to PD-1 and B7.1 (CD80)
Standard in SCLC, NSCLC, urothelial, and hepatocellular carcinoma

steps.tx: Co-stimulatory inhibition during initial antigen presentation operates through a distinct biological mechanism. **CTLA-4 inhibitor** ipilimumab blocks CTLA-4 outcompeting CD28 for B7 costimulatory molecules during initial **T-cell priming** in secondary lymphoid organs. Because CTLA-4 possesses greater binding affinity for CD80 and CD86 than CD28, therapeutic blockade disinhibits naive T-cell priming and promotes clonal expansion within draining regional lymph nodes.

nodes.label: Naive T Cell Expressing CTLA-4 & CD28

steps.tx: Simultaneous targeting of central priming and peripheral exhaustion pathways achieves clinical synergy. Dual immune **checkpoint inhibition** combining nivolumab and ipilimumab provides **synergistic** responses in metastatic melanoma, renal cell carcinoma, and MSI-H colorectal cancer. In the CheckMate-067 trial, dual checkpoint blockade yielded unprecedented long-term overall survival exceeding 50% at 7.5 years, albeit with high rates of grade 3-4 immune-related adverse events.

rows: Superior OS and ORR compared to sunitinib

steps.tx: Next-generation checkpoint inhibitors overcome secondary resistance by targeting non-redundant inhibitory pathways. **Relatlimab** is an inhibitory antibody targeting LAG-3, combining with nivolumab to overcome adaptive resistance in untreated metastatic melanoma. **LAG-3** binds stable MHC class II molecules on antigen-presenting cells with higher affinity than CD4, transmitting negative signals that arrest T-cell expansion; co-blockade with nivolumab demonstrated superior progression-free survival in the RELATIVITY-047 study.

steps.tx: Hyperprogression represents an alarming accelerated pattern of tumour growth seen in up to 10% of patients treated with immune **checkpoint inhibitors**, correlated with MDM2 amplification. **Hyperprogressive disease** denotes dramatic acceleration of tumour growth rate exceeding a twofold increase during early therapy. The biological etiology involves pre-existing tumour-infiltrating Fc receptor-bearing macrophages cross-linking anti-PD-1 antibodies or expanding immunosuppressive regulatory T cells.

left.title: Pseudoprogression
items: Transient radiological enlargement followed by shrinkage
Driven by intensive cytotoxic T-cell tumour infiltration and edema
Patient remains clinically stable or shows symptom improvement
Observed in 2% to 8% of solid tumours treated with IO

right.title: Hyperprogressive Disease (HPD)
items: Rapid tumour acceleration with > 2-fold growth rate (TGIR > 2)
Accompanied by rapid clinical performance status deterioration
Associated with MDM2/MDM4 amplification or EGFR mutations

steps.tx: **Pembrolizumab** received the first FDA **tissue-agnostic** approval for any solid tumour exhibiting mismatch repair deficiency or **microsatellite instability-high** status. High tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes correlate with improved response rates and survival across solid tumours treated with checkpoint inhibitors. Tumours are classified immunologically as inflamed hot tumours exhibiting dense CD8+ T-cell infiltration, or cold tumours lacking intratumoural T cells.

steps.tx: Predictive biomarkers guide patient selection for immune checkpoint inhibition across multiple organ sites. **PD-L1 immunohistochemistry** reporting includes tumour proportion score TPS and **combined positive score** CPS to predict checkpoint inhibitor responsiveness. In gastric, cervical, and head and neck carcinomas, CPS incorporates PD-L1-staining tumour cells, lymphocytes, and macrophages relative to viable tumour cells, establishing actionable therapeutic cut-offs.
